readability.reads_as: a dip with the strip stood upright, then strip swings
readability.note: To stand the 1 m strip upright under STRIP_TOP_M 1.84 the TCP has to go DOWN 0.28 m (z 1.45 -> 1.17, t 0.2-2.8 s, ghosts 2-4): the 'raise' reads as a sink. The held sabre (2.8-3.7 s) is there, the 'cut' flourish is two strip swings (t 3.7-5.0 and 5.3-6.4 s, J6 range 119 deg, 82 % speed, strip tips 1.35 m/s vs TCP 0.05) - from the audience the same face-on fan as high_15_twirl, which does it bigger (140 deg) - and the last move (t 7.4-8.3 s) goes UP back to the hub, the opposite of a bow. From this hub the family's shape is inverted by the strip's top limit.
